extractions.extraction_text: A  P / 200(1)  0,80 m(2) La anchura de toda hoja de puerta no debe ser menor que 0,60 m, ni  exceder de 1,23 m.

attributes.norm_statement: The width of any door leaf must not be less than 0.60 m, nor exceed 1.23 m. The clear width (A) must be greater than or equal to the occupancy (P) divided by 200, and greater than or equal to 0.80 m.
attributes.satisfied_if: DOOR.LEAF.WIDTH >= 0.60 AND DOOR.LEAF.WIDTH <= 1.23 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= (OCCUPANCY / 200) AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= 0.80
attributes.notes: P refers to the occupancy, A refers to the clear width.

attributes.norm_statement: The clear width (A) of corridors and ramps must be greater than or equal to the occupancy (P) divided by 200, and greater than or equal to 1.00 m.
attributes.notes: P refers to the occupancy, A refers to the clear width.

extractions.extraction_text: En filas con salida a pasillo únicamente por uno de sus extremos, A ≥ 30  cm cuando tengan 7 asientos y 2,5 cm más por cada asiento adicional,  hasta un máximo admisible de 12 asientos. En filas con salida a pasillo por sus dos extremos, A ≥ 30 cm en filas de 14  asientos como máximo y 1,25 cm más por cada asiento adicional. Para 30  asientos o más: A  50 cm.(7) Cada 25 filas, como máximo, se dispondrá un paso entre filas cuya anchu ra sea 1,20 m, como mínimo.

attributes.norm_statement: In rows with exit to aisle only at one end, the clear width (A) must be ≥ 30 cm for 7 seats, with an additional 2.5 cm per additional seat, up to a maximum of 12 seats. In rows with exit to aisle at both ends, A must be ≥ 30 cm for a maximum of 14 seats, with an additional 1.25 cm per additional seat. For 30 seats or more, A must be ≥ 50 cm. A passage between rows with a minimum width of 1.20 m must be provided every 25 rows at most.
attributes.satisfied_if: (ROW.EXIT.TYPE == 'ONE_END' AND ROW.SEATS == 7 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= 0.30) OR (ROW.EXIT.TYPE == 'ONE_END' AND ROW.SEATS > 7 AND ROW.SEATS <= 12 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= (0.30 + (ROW.SEATS - 7) * 0.025)) OR (ROW.EXIT.TYPE == 'BOTH_ENDS' AND ROW.SEATS <= 14 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= 0.30) OR (ROW.EXIT.TYPE == 'BOTH_ENDS' AND ROW.SEATS > 14 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= (0.30 + (ROW.SEATS - 14) * 0.0125)) OR (ROW.SEATS >= 30 AND CLEAR_WIDTH >= 0.50); OR (ROW.COUNT % 25 == 0 AND PASSAGE.BETWEEN_ROWS.WIDTH >= 1.20)
attributes.notes: A refers to the clear width.
